description: EPRI's Load Shape Library version (LSL)TM 8.0 is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The Load Shape Library (LSL)TM 8.0 and the Library PLUS 1.0 versions are intended to demonstrate basic features of Load Shape Profiling. The Load Shape Library is planned to evolve into a tool with enhanced features and capabilities to house future end use load data collection activities by EPRI, electric utilities and other partners. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are buildings, electric gas load shapes, natural gas load shapes, Advanced Metering Infrastructure meters, AMI meters. The portal shows 2024-07-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is EPRI Terms of Use (https://www.epri.com/help/privacy/terms-of-use). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
